lens_summary.drift: REC-C1.5 closure: every step in the user-approved plan lands with green evidence. Bootstrap invariant R5 regression-verified by commenting out bootstrap_execution_logs (test reports registry_len=0 vs expected 2).

findings.title: ExecutionLog root resolver must be canonical (env-overridable, OnceLock-backed)
evidence: 4 unit tests in chronos-log covering env round-trip, two-call equality, override seam, default-fallback determinism

findings.title: MCP startup must call bootstrap_execution_logs (no caller-driven step required)
delete_session must remove durable ExecutionLog (not just in-memory handle)
evidence: DeleteResult.paths_removed surfaces what was actually removed
UAT-R4: delete + restart → next reader sees SessionNotFound

findings.title: Clean session stop must write tail_state=Sealed to manifest
evidence: UAT-R3: clean stop → restart reads Sealed and skips bootstrap reopen

findings.title: try_new must immediately populate the registry (no caller bootstrap)
evidence: bootstrap_readiness::new_immediately_populates_registry_from_disk assertion fails (registry_len=0) when bootstrap_execution_logs is commented out
